blocks.html: Any subdivision of a plan review site that is proposed to take place within the Special District shall be filed with the Department of City Planning, and the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission shall certify that subdivision of such plan review site:
blocks.plainText: Any subdivision of a plan review site that is proposed to take place within the Special District shall be filed with the Department of City Planning, and the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission shall certify that subdivision of such plan review site:

blocks.html:
1. does not contain, or have frontage along, any District Plan Element listed in Section 107-20 (DISTRICT PLAN ELEMENTS), inclusive;
  2. does not contain an area of no land alteration;
  3. does not exceed the rate of two tree credits per 1,000 square feet of lot area; and
  4. does not have a violation for tree removal without prior permission or approval and no trees have been removed since November 2, 2023, unless permitted pursuant to Section 107-312 (Regulations within plan review sites).
blocks.plainText: does not contain, or have frontage along, any District Plan Element listed in Section 107-20 (DISTRICT PLAN ELEMENTS), inclusive; does not contain an area of no land alteration; does not exceed the rate of two tree credits per 1,000 square feet of lot area; and does not have a violation for tree removal without prior permission or approval and no trees have been removed since November 2, 2023, unless permitted pursuant to Section 107-312 (Regulations within plan review sites).

blocks.html: In the case of a subdivision which does not comply with the above conditions, subdivision of such plan review site shall not be permitted unless authorized by the Commission pursuant to Section 107-64 (Future Subdivision of Certain Plan Review Sites).
blocks.plainText: In the case of a subdivision which does not comply with the above conditions, subdivision of such plan review site shall not be permitted unless authorized by the Commission pursuant to Section 107-64 (Future Subdivision of Certain Plan Review Sites).

blocks.html: The subdivision plan for the plan review site shall include a survey map in accordance with the requirements set forth in Section 107-03 (Requirements for Certification, Authorization or Special Permit Application).
blocks.plainText: The subdivision plan for the plan review site shall include a survey map in accordance with the requirements set forth in Section 107-03 (Requirements for Certification, Authorization or Special Permit Application).

blocks.html: For the purpose of applying the provisions of this Section, a subdivision includes the reconfiguration of a zoning lot in a manner that would reduce the area of such zoning lot.
blocks.plainText: For the purpose of applying the provisions of this Section, a subdivision includes the reconfiguration of a zoning lot in a manner that would reduce the area of such zoning lot.

amendmentHistory.notes: Title change (formerly just "Future Subdivision"). Also added #plan review site# language; added (a)-(d); deleted DOS reference; consolidated survey map requirements language.
amendmentHistory.description: An amendment modifying the Special South Richmond Development District (Article X, Chapter 7)
